_readme: Verified women's college soccer programs. Edit this file to add or update a college, then run: php artisan db:seed --class=CollegeSeeder. Use null for anything not verified from an official source. Costs are published prices before financial aid. Private colleges list the same price for in-state and out-of-state.

colleges.name: Rutgers University-New Brunswick
colleges.programs_note: No standalone education bachelor's degree reported; teacher preparation is a five-year B.A./Ed.M. program through the Graduate School of Education.
colleges.cost_note: Published total covers tuition, fees, on-campus housing and food only (no books, travel or personal costs).

sources.note: Five-year teacher education program
